services.name: Clear Kayak Three Sisters Springs & Manatee Tour
services.desc: There's no better way to experience the beauty of Crystal River, Three Sisters Springs, and manatees than in a clear kayak! Our guided ecotour in our all-clear kayaks is the number one-rated tour in all of Crystal River. Sorry, no pets are allowed on any of our tours. Ages 3 & up only. About What To Expect You will journey out to some of the clearest water in the world in our ALL clear kayaks with one of our amazing LOCAL guides. You will learn about our ecosystem and possibly spot local wildlife such as manatees, turtles, various birds, dolphins, and many species of fish. Manatee season ends April 1st Through November 14th

services.name: Clear Kayak Three Sisters Springs Sunset & Glow Tour
services.desc: There's no better way to experience the beauty of Crystal River than with Sunsets, Three Sisters Springs, and Glow Tours in ALL Clear Kayaks.# This one-of-a-kind night tour gives you the best of both worlds in Crystal River. You will tour the world famous Three Sisters Springs and then venture to catch a sunset before the second half of your tour begins. After catching one of our spectacular sunsets, we turn the lights on the kayaks to see EVERYTHING that is going on below the surface! You have the possibility of spotting various kinds of wildlife we have to offer here, such as manatees, April 1st Through November 14th
